    print(0)
    exit()

oc = 0

for i in range(n):
    if arr[i] % 2 == 0:
        ec += 1
    else:
        oc += 1
    if ec > 0 and oc > 0 and ec == oc:

    list_values = list(map_dict.values())
    if list_values[0] <= b:
        print(1)
        exit()
    else:
        print(0)
        exit()
else:
    list_values = sorted(map_dict.values())
    k = 0
    while k < len(list_values):
        if list_values[k] <= b:
            b -= list_values[k]
            k += 1
        else:
            break
    print(k)
